(async()=>{const r=window.raid; const run = r.copy(); const kinds = ['crab7','finch','worm']; let i = 0; for (const p of run.board) if (p) { p.kind = kinds[i++ % 3]; p.items = []; } run.stage.picks[0].options = ['thorn','plume','chestnut']; run.items.push('thorn','chestnut'); r.redraw(); r.skip(0.6); return run.board.filter(Boolean).map(p => p.kind).join(' ') + ' | ' + run.items.join(' ');})()
